elaine (finance): Heads-up — starting 2026-05-01 we're making two billing policy changes: 1) unify merchant tiers into a single 'Pro' meter with clearer invoice line labels per region; 2) auto-reconcile lingering free/credit balances older than 90 days into a single 'account credit' line (will appear as CR_adj). We'll run a dry-run report next week.

josh (billing): Can you confirm if this affects reserved capacity invoices and Dedicated contracts? @elaine

elaine (finance): Short answer: no changes to committed reserved capacity billing or enterprise contract line items. This is about hosted API free credits / trial credits and promotional credits, plus some legacy per-route line tags. Dedicated customers will get separate notification if we need to change labels.

sam (ops): Will rate-limit cushions be affected? Our routing uses per-route quotas.

elaine (finance): Rates unchanged. This is cosmetic and reconciliation behavior only. The only functional change: credits older than 90 days will be consolidated and will no longer be attached to individual route IDs. That may affect per-route cost attribution in Console. There will be an exportable mapping during dry-run.

kevin (cto): Heads up to SDK teams: the invoice_line_item name field may change from 'free_credit_xyz' to 'CR_adj' or 'promo_credit'. Please handle unexpected label variants gracefully. Suggest we add a parser update in billing client lib.

josh (billing): Thanks. We'll publish a migration patch v0.13.2 to billing-js with tolerant parsing. Anyone object to adding a fallback mapping?

anita (legal): Reviewed — consolidation is fine. Need to add copy to T&Cs about expirations and reconciliation. Will send suggested language by EOD.

billing-bot: Automated report: Dry-run CSV created: https://internal/reports/billing/dryrun/2410001111.csv (view-only).

elaine (finance): Plan: dry-run March 30-31, stakeholder review April 4, rollout May 1. If you rely on per-route attribution for chargebacks, please reply to this thread by March 28 so we can whitelist your account.

sam (ops): :thumbsup: confirming we'll add a Console migration flag to show both old and new labels in preview mode.

josh (billing): Quick example of invoice JSON change for parsers:

```
"line_items": [
  {"id":"li_123", "type":"usage", "label":"tokens.generated", "amount": 1234},
  {"id":"li_124", "type":"credit", "label":"CR_adj", "amount": -50}
]
```

elaine (finance): Thanks — last note: regional VAT labels will move to a new field 'tax_label_region' to avoid ambiguous line labeling. Finance will publish sample invoices.

kevin (cto): Thanks all.
